description: Apparent tropical geocentric core WASM versus Swiss Ephemeris; sameUT uses independent delta T; sameTT uses core delta T for both. Absolute-error percentiles use linear interpolation. Thresholds are descriptive, not user requirements.
limitation: Six-hour grid plus 10000 deterministic random instants and explicit samples is not continuous certification. No interpretations changed.
timeConvention: jdUT and utIso use conventional UT1 Julian days rendered as calendar ISO labels; no UT1-to-UTC or leap-second conversion. Historical and future delta T values are models, not asserted observations.

coreManifest.sourceHashScope: Rust/TOML sources plus BIN/JSON ephemeris assets under core/data and core/src/astronomy; wasm package artifacts
